description: This file defines the 'Newsletter' controller class for the OpenCart online store platform. It manages the display and updating of a customer's newsletter subscription status within the account section, including rendering the newsletter view and processing save requests.

classes.name: Controller\Account\Newsletter
classes.description: Controller class for managing the newsletter subscription page for customer accounts, including rendering the view and handling updates.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles displaying the newsletter subscription page, setting up navigation breadcrumbs, and rendering the view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes the saving of the newsletter subscription status, including user validation, updating the customer record, and returning JSON response.
